home.title: Home
home.description: Start a jam, invite people nearby, and everyone sees the same chords in time with the beat. Suggest the next song or key and vote together.

install.title: Get the app
install.description: Add Jamming.me to your home screen to start or join a jam with one tap, in full screen.
install.ios: Tap {share} Share in Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.android: Open the browser menu ⋮ and choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
